description: SHAPE: `data` is a TOP-LEVEL ARRAY of `{name, canonical_code, mention_count, latest_at}` — no `items` wrapper (write `[*].name`). Stocks most mentioned by sell-side research notes; array order is the rank. `mention_count` is every mention in the window, not deduplicated. ⚠️ Sell-side attention, not retail — retail attention is `social_hot`; the two do not validate each other. HK names appear and can lead (`HK:` prefix). Window: trailing `hours` (default 24), or with `date` the previous trading day's 15:00 → that day's 15:00 (China time). ⚠️ Walk trading days, not calendar days — a weekend `date` returns a cumulative, overlapping window; drive the walk from `trading_days`. ⚠️ Windows differ in length (a Monday spans the weekend), so `mention_count` does not compare across days as-is; rank within a day does. An empty array means no mentions (failures return 503). History starts 2026-02-25 — earlier dates are *not covered*, not quiet.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

date.description: Trading day YYYY-MM-DD (China time). Window = previous trading day's close 15:00 → that day's close 15:00; mention_count is every mention inside it, counted in full. Omit for the rolling `hours` window ending now.

hours.description: Rolling window in hours ending now (1-168, default 24). Ignored when `date` is given.

name: hot
